jd:
Chicago Symphony Youth Ensemble is hiring a Summer Music Intern to support our summer concert series.

Responsibilities:
- Assist with rehearsal logistics and stage setup for weekly concerts
- Coordinate sheet music distribution among ensemble members
- Support front-of-house volunteers during performances

Minimum Qualifications:
- Currently pursuing a degree in Music Performance or a related field
- Prior experience performing in an ensemble (orchestra, band, or choir)
- Comfortable using basic audio recording or editing software
- Strong written and verbal communication skills

What We Offer:
- A stipend and free tickets to our summer concert series

Chicago Symphony Youth Ensemble is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
resume:
Jordan Rivera
jordan.rivera@example.com · (312) 555-0142 · Chicago, IL

Summary
Third-year Music Performance student at DePaul University with four years of experience performing violin in the DePaul Symphony Orchestra and the Chicago Youth Orchestra. Comfortable editing rehearsal recordings in Audacity. Organized sheet music logistics for a 60-member ensemble during the 2025 spring tour.

Experience
Section Violinist — DePaul Symphony Orchestra, 2022–Present
- Performed in twelve subscription concerts per season
- Organized and distributed sheet music for new repertoire each semester

Volunteer Coordinator — Chicago Youth Orchestra Summer Festival, 2024
- Managed front-of-house volunteers for six evening performances
- Edited and uploaded rehearsal recordings for section review

Education
B.M. in Music Performance, DePaul University, Expected 2026
